purpose: Durable local continuation for registered workflow obligations (D-RECOVERY). Bookkeeping only: registering, reading, claiming or settling an obligation never creates a task, decision, issue, approval, completion, publication or cleanup, and never grants authority.

storage.resolution: git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir from the real (non-reparse) repository root, as _artifactauthoritylib._spool_root does
path_rules: every directory on the path is a real directory (no symlink, no reparse point)
every record file is a regular file opened without following links
names are derived from validated identities, never from caller text
reads never leave the owned subtree
storage.dormant_project: never read, never created: only an active project (arbiter: enabled) may read an existing ledger, and only an explicit write creates the subtree
storage.snapshot: excluded: the native snapshot never hashes .git (core/artifacts/internal/validate/input_policy.go IsGitPath), and a linked worktree's common directory lies outside its checkout
storage.portability: local to this repository's Git directory; not portable work evidence, not a backup, not durable after that Git directory is deleted
storage.inventory: documented runtime path owned by the workflow-recovery helper; doctor/status may report it, cleanup may not delete pending/claimed/unavailable records

bounds.oversize: explicit unavailable/partial result; never silently truncate a candidate into a different obligation

unknown_kind_or_version: unavailable: preserved byte-for-byte, reported as bounded metadata, never overwritten, downgraded or deleted
work_ref_none: authorized ordinary work without an enrolled task registers with work_ref 'none'; registering never requires creating a task

authority_context.note: names the authority source for audit; revalidated at effect time; never a reusable grant

record.forbidden_content: no full transcript, raw debug packet, secret, credential, raw rejected payload, arbitrary command, shell text, or executable path

identities.obligation_id: ob-<sha256(repository_id, workflow_run_id, kind, origin)[:32]>: stable across discovery replay, restart and reentry; never derived from a timestamp or the current session
identities.candidate_revision: increments only on an authorized correction under compare-and-swap; the previous candidate stays in history; a new revision never overwrites an effect of unknown outcome
identities.effect_operation_id: op-<sha256(obligation_id, candidate_revision, target owner, action)[:32]>: an exact retry reuses it with the immutable payload; a corrected attempt gets a new linked attempt only after the earlier effect is known absent or settled

reason_recovery.io-temporary: retry the same explicit operation once storage is readable
reason_recovery.storage-unavailable: repair storage access; nothing was registered
reason_recovery.capacity: settle or explicitly dispose older obligations; nothing older is evicted
reason_recovery.unsupported-version: use a reader that supports this version; the bytes are preserved
reason_recovery.unknown-kind: install the version that registered this kind; the bytes are preserved
reason_recovery.corrupt-record: inspect the preserved bytes through the explicit recovery path; no automatic repair
reason_recovery.changed-binding: revalidate the source/work binding in the current context
reason_recovery.source-stale: re-run discovery against the current source
reason_recovery.owner-ambiguous: resolve the single target owner (dual owner refuses)
reason_recovery.authorization-denied: a correction cannot clear this; only a new real grant from the host or user can
reason_recovery.explicit-stop: a correction cannot clear this; only the user lifting the stop can
reason_recovery.material-unavailable: restore the required material, then resume
reason_recovery.uncertain-effect: reconcile by exact operation/origin readback before any retry
reason_recovery.target-unavailable: wait for the target owner; never write through a second owner

transitions.guard: registered kind and version; closed bounded fields valid; storage writable under the writer lock
transitions.effects: write record and index under one recoverable write intent; return durable:true with obligation_id and record_revision; no task, issue or decision write

transitions.guard: invalid, oversize or unknown-kind input, or storage unavailable
transitions.effects: bounded sanitized diagnostic and durable:false; ordinary unrelated work continues; no record invented
transitions.on_reject: not applicable: this is the rejection

transitions.guard: same obligation identity and byte-identical candidate
transitions.effects: return the existing obligation_id and record_revision; nothing rewritten
transitions.on_reject: a different candidate is a conflict requiring an explicit correction, never idempotent success

transitions.guard: authorized correction; expected record_revision matches; no unreconciled effect
transitions.effects: candidate.revision+1 and record_revision+1; previous candidate kept in history
transitions.on_reject: revision conflict returns the current state unchanged

transitions.guard: active project; bounded read
transitions.effects: read-only bounded summary with complete/partial/unavailable inventory and a resume route; never executes promotion, cleanup, publication or review
transitions.on_reject: an unreadable index reports partial/unavailable, never an empty inventory

transitions.guard: workflow terminal step or explicit resume; current source/work binding holds; actual current effect authority holds; per-obligation OS lock acquired; expected record_revision matches
transitions.effects: persist the claim and immutable effect intent before calling the target adapter
transitions.on_reject: lock held: WR-12 busy; revision mismatch: current state unchanged

transitions.guard: target owner ambiguous, source stale, unsupported kind/version, actual scope denied, or required material unavailable
transitions.effects: retain the candidate and a precise reason; pause only this dependent effect; no fallback owner and no universal approval request
transitions.on_reject: not applicable: this is the refusal

transitions.guard: interactive preview explicitly declined; the decline audit event committed durably
transitions.effects: composite journey: WR-06 first persists the immutable decline-audit intent; exact audit readback settles through WR-09 or recovered WR-11 with disposition declined; one idempotent decline event and terminal receipt, no board or question write
transitions.on_reject: an uncertain audit commit keeps the recoverable attempt claimed; WR-10/WR-11 reconciliation must determine the effect before retry, never demote an unknown effect to pending

transitions.guard: the target reports success and exact readback (operation or origin) proves the effect or an exact-origin reuse
transitions.effects: persist target id and receipt digest; infer no parent completion, review pass, merge or cleanup

transitions.guard: the target response was lost or the claimant died after the effect may have committed
transitions.effects: a later executor acquires the released OS lock and queries exact operation/origin; it never blindly replays an unknown effect

transitions.guard: reconciliation readback proves the exact intended effect exists
transitions.effects: record the recovered receipt; no duplicate write; independently edited target content is not overwritten

transitions.guard: another live process holds the per-obligation OS lock
transitions.effects: report busy with bounded metadata; no TTL-based theft; no global session wait

transitions.guard: reconciliation proves the effect did not commit; current binding and authority still hold
transitions.effects: record the failed attempt; keep the immutable effect identity for an exact retry; no permission fabricated

transitions.guard: outcome cannot be determined, target unavailable, or source/authority changed
transitions.effects: retain the unresolved effect intent and reason; new revisions and effects for this obligation wait for reconciliation

transitions.guard: read-only status or reentry
transitions.effects: show the reason and its legitimate recovery route; identical notices may be suppressed per session without discarding state

transitions.guard: the relevant condition changed; bindings and real authority revalidated; any previous effect reconciled; reason not in correction_cannot_clear unless a real new grant or lifted stop is observed
transitions.effects: record the reason-specific recovery
transitions.on_reject: a formatting correction alone cannot clear authorization-denied or explicit-stop

transitions.guard: unknown schema version, unknown kind, or malformed bytes on disk
transitions.effects: preserve the bytes under owned access; report bounded safe metadata only; no overwrite, deletion, downgrade or empty-state interpretation

transitions.guard: explicit authorized cancellation; no unreconciled effect
transitions.effects: retain the disposition
transitions.on_reject: an unreconciled effect keeps the current state

transitions.guard: explicit authorized supersession naming the replacement obligation; no unreconciled effect
transitions.effects: retain the disposition and link the replacement
transitions.on_reject: an unreconciled effect keeps the current state

transitions.guard: exact registration, retry or notification replay
transitions.effects: return the terminal receipt or tombstone and target link; no repeated effect or prompt

transitions.guard: new authorized follow-up after changed facts
transitions.effects: register a NEW linked obligation using a new workflow_run_id, a distinct origin naming the settled predecessor, and candidate.provenance retaining that relation; the old history stays immutable and is never reopened

transitions.guard: a record or index write failed after a possible commit point
transitions.effects: re-read and report requested, observed and committed/durable facts separately; never silently revert a later writer

forbidden_transition_rule: No forbidden trigger may move an obligation to settled, grant authority, or mark work complete. There is no age-triggered pending to settled, no error to complete, and no validation-pass to authorization-granted.

fields.durable: true only when the record and index commit was observed
fields.observed_state: state read back after the operation, or unknown
fields.count: exact only when inventory is complete; a lower bound when partial; unknown when unavailable
fields.cursor: opaque continuation bound to index generation and page identity; a stale cursor restarts or reports changed inventory
fields.denied: an actual host/user denial, distinct from unavailable

result.empty_success_forbidden: an incomplete or unreadable read never reports zero pending obligations as complete

retention.unresolved: pending, claimed and unavailable records are kept until an observed effect or explicit authorized disposition settles them; never aged out, budget-evicted, or removed because a branch was deleted or an agent said done
retention.capacity: registration reports durable:false; nothing older is evicted
retention.tombstone: settled records may compact to immutable tombstones keeping obligation/operation/origin identity, disposition, target reference and receipt digest; exact ID lookup and dedup survive compaction
retention.cleanup_authority: ledger maintenance never deletes a live target, worktree, branch, transcript or pending record; it is not an exception to ADR-0036 cleanup authorization

compatibility.older_versions: ignore the owned runtime directory without deleting it
compatibility.unknown_versions: readable only as bounded unavailable metadata; never overwritten with a lower version
compatibility.absence: no ledger means no registered obligations, not that all historical workflows completed
compatibility.legacy_import: only an explicit bounded operation with source checksums and exact origins; never a startup mining pass
compatibility.rollback: disables new writers and notifications while preserving the ledger and target records; reverting source does not roll back observed effects

adr_boundaries.ADR-0008: commit-gate harvest still runs at Phase 7 before staging so promoted work rides the work commit; a pending record surviving an abandoned branch never makes the follow-up authoritative on another branch; startup stages nothing
adr_boundaries.ADR-0036: recovery-ledger retention does not supersede per-item/group cleanup authority and supplies no deletion relaxation
adr_boundaries.ADR-0043: registration and reentry are assistive bookkeeping: no new approval ceremony, no universal gate; only work that depends on an unavailable obligation waits
